mapper.select: SELECT id, file_name as fileName, file_relative_path as fileRelativePath, file_size as fileSize, file_type as fileType, status, fail_msg as failMsg, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime FROM kb_document ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_document (id, file_name, file_relative_path, file_size, file_type, status, fail_msg, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{fileName}, #{fileRelativePath}, #{fileSize}, #{fileType}, #{status}, #{failMsg}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, file_name as fileName, file_relative_path as fileRelativePath, file_size as fileSize, file_type as fileType, status, fail_msg as failMsg, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime FROM kb_document WHERE id = #{id}
